pages.title: What the pit calls up
text: The pit calls up exactly what a silk-touch mining trip would: the **raw item** for a metal, the **ore block** for a gem. Each cycle eats its substrate and gives one result.
Substrates are renewable on purpose: stone from a [Stone Font](stone_font), March Stone from cobble.

pages.title: The four bands
text: - **Common**: coal, copper and iron. **10 seconds** at **28 Pulse a second**, on **two stone**.
- **Deep**: gold, redstone and lapis. **15 seconds** at **32**, on **two March Stone**. Quartz is not in this band.
- **Hot**: the Nether's quartz and gold ore. **20 seconds** at **36**, on two March Stone, with **Fire**.

- **Rare**: diamond, emerald, and any metal or gem the grit scan found in your pack. **40 seconds** at **24**, on **four March Stone and a Spirit Shard**, with **Spirit**. About one rare cycle in four gives double.

pages.title: Which band it hears
text: Deep, hot and rare need [Deep Listening](listening_pit) and the standing to match. Without a sample, a pit below **y 0** listens one band deeper, and Spirit takes it one deeper again.
If standing or shape will not carry it that far, the pit settles for the deepest band it may reach instead of stalling.
Below y 0, or over deepslate, gems come up as deepslate ores.

pages.title: Samples
text: A sample is a filter, never an ingredient. Seat one by right-clicking the mesh with a raw metal, grit or gem.

A material the sample names weighs **six times** as much as anything else in the band. A sample also asks for the deepest band that holds it and the pit may reach: gold means the hot band when Fire is lit, the deep band otherwise.
A sample no reachable band holds is ignored, and the Codex says so.

pages.title: Voices at the pit
text: Earth is required. Each other voice trades one thing for another; none is a plain multiplier.
- **Water** washes: one extra output every **third** cycle, for **250 mB** from the mesh's tank. Fill it with a bucket; it holds 4,000 mB.
- **Air** quickens the cycle to about **0.65** of its time and charges about **1.55 times** the Pulse a second. Pulse per item does not move.
- **Fire** opens the hot band at 36 Pulse a second.
- **Spirit** listens a band deeper and opens the rare one.
- **The Loom** halves the substrate, rounded up.

pages.title: What it costs
text: The Pulse figures above are before pack settings. The default **2.0** consumption multiplier doubles them, so one iron cycle is **280 Pulse** on two stone before settings and **560** at the shipped default.
A pack pit-speed setting shortens the cycle without raising Pulse a second, so it also cheapens each cycle.
Mining still costs less Pulse per ingot. The pit's gift is that it never runs out.
